standard: founder_instruction 889, 893, 894: professional knowledge for the seat's own work

items.q_en: Should the site redirect Arabic-speaking visitors automatically to the Arabic pages?
items.q_ar: هل يعيد الموقع توجيه الزوار الناطقين بالعربية تلقائياً إلى الصفحات العربية؟
items.q_reworded: A Dubai visitor with Arabic browser settings lands on our English homepage. Should we bounce them straight to /ar?
answer_must: No automatic language redirects
Offer a visible language switch; let crawlers reach both versions

items.q_en: What must hreflang annotations between English and Arabic pages look like?
items.q_ar: كيف يجب أن تكون وسوم hreflang بين الصفحات الإنجليزية والعربية؟
items.q_reworded: Our developer is adding the language tags that link the English and Arabic versions. What must he get right?
answer_must: Each page must reference the other (reciprocal) and itself
Include an x-default fallback

items.q_en: What are the Core Web Vitals thresholds?
items.q_ar: ما حدود مؤشرات أداء الويب الأساسية؟
items.q_reworded: The site feels slow on phones. What speed numbers does Google treat as good?
answer_must: LCP within 2.5 seconds
INP within 200 ms
CLS at or below 0.1

items.q_en: Can we pay a construction blog for a link to our site?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن أن ندفع لمدونة بناء مقابل رابط لموقعنا؟
expected_facts: never pay for a followed link
items.q_reworded: A contracting magazine offers us a backlink for AED 500. Is that worth doing?
answer_must: Paying for a followed link is link spam
Any paid link must be marked rel="sponsored"; earn links through data and PR instead

items.q_en: How do we get our explainer videos to show in Google search?
items.q_ar: كيف نجعل فيديوهاتنا التعريفية تظهر في بحث جوجل؟
items.q_reworded: Our how-it-works clip never appears in Google results. What are we missing?
answer_must: Mark it up with VideoObject structured data
Give each video its own indexable page with thumbnail and description

items.q_en: Our reel got views but nobody clicked. Which numbers should we read?
items.q_ar: حقق مقطعنا مشاهدات لكن لم ينقر أحد، أي أرقام نقرأ؟
items.q_reworded: A reel reached 20,000 people but brought zero sign-ups. Which numbers tell us what went wrong?
answer_must: Check hook rate / early retention to see if people stayed
Check link clicks and landing conversion, not views

items.q_en: How do we know whether our Meta ads actually caused the sign-ups?
items.q_ar: كيف نعرف أن إعلانات ميتا سببت التسجيلات فعلاً؟
items.q_reworded: The agency says Facebook brought us 40 suppliers. How do we check that is real?
answer_must: Platform-reported conversions are an upper bound
Prove causation with a holdout or lift test

items.q_en: What does Gmail require from our bulk marketing emails?
items.q_ar: ماذا تشترط جيميل على رسائلنا التسويقية الجماعية؟
items.q_reworded: Our supplier newsletter is going to spam in Gmail. What do the big mailbox providers demand?
answer_must: Authenticate the domain and offer one-click unsubscribe
Keep spam complaints under 0.3%

items.q_en: How fast should we respond to a supplier who started sign-up?
items.q_ar: بأي سرعة نرد على مورد بدأ التسجيل؟
items.q_reworded: A contractor half-finished registration this morning. When should someone reach out?
answer_must: Within an hour while intent is fresh
Response time is measured in minutes, not days

items.q_en: How do we measure share of voice against competitors?
items.q_ar: كيف نقيس حصة الصوت مقابل المنافسين؟
items.q_reworded: How do we tell if we are louder than other quote platforms online?
answer_must: Measure share of voice against the same competitor set each time
Compare share of voice with market share (excess share of voice)

items.q_en: Can we launch a free first month for suppliers in Dubai right away?
items.q_ar: هل نطلق شهراً أول مجانياً للموردين في دبي فوراً؟
items.q_reworded: Sales wants a "first month free" offer for Dubai suppliers starting Monday. Anything to check?
answer_must: Promotions in Dubai may need a Department of Economy and Tourism permit
Run a permit check before launch

items.q_en: What content belongs at the bottom of the funnel?
items.q_ar: ما المحتوى الذي ينتمي إلى أسفل القمع؟
items.q_reworded: What should a procurement manager who is almost ready to buy be reading from us?
answer_must: Bottom-of-funnel content: pricing pages, fees and comparisons
Proof that removes the final doubt

items.q_en: What is the difference between GEO and classic SEO for our marketplace?
items.q_ar: ما الفرق بين تحسين الظهور في محركات الإجابة التوليدية وتحسين محركات البحث التقليدي لمنصتنا؟
items.q_reworded: The founder asks why we need anything beyond normal SEO now that people ask chatbots. What do you tell him?
answer_must: SEO targets a ranked list of links; GEO targets being the source an answer engine quotes
Crawlability and authority still matter for both

items.q_en: Which crawler must we allow so our pages can appear in ChatGPT search?
items.q_ar: أي زاحف يجب أن نسمح به لكي تظهر صفحاتنا في بحث ChatGPT؟
expected_facts: GPTBot is the separate training crawler
items.q_reworded: IT wants to block AI bots in robots.txt. Which one must stay open so ChatGPT search can show us?
answer_must: Allow OAI-SearchBot
GPTBot is the separate training crawler and can be decided separately

items.q_en: How long should the direct answer under each question heading be?
items.q_ar: ما الطول المناسب للإجابة المباشرة تحت كل عنوان سؤال؟
items.q_reworded: How should the opening of each FAQ answer on our site be written?
answer_must: A direct answer of about 40-70 words immediately under the question heading
Elaborate after the direct answer

items.q_en: Is an llms.txt file required, and what is its only mandatory element?
items.q_ar: هل ملف llms.txt إلزامي، وما عنصره الإلزامي الوحيد؟
expected_facts: The only mandatory element is an H1
items.q_reworded: Do we have to publish an llms.txt file, and what has to be in it?
answer_must: It is optional, not a standard requirement
Its only mandatory element is an H1 title

items.q_en: How do we measure whether answer engines mention QuotesDone?
items.q_ar: كيف نقيس ما إذا كانت محركات الإجابة تذكر QuotesDone؟
items.q_reworded: How can we tell if Perplexity and Gemini talk about us at all?
answer_must: Run a fixed prompt panel monthly
Repeat each prompt three times and record mentions and citations

items.q_en: Can the Arabic page canonicalise to the English version?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز أن تشير الصفحة العربية بالرابط القانوني إلى النسخة الإنجليزية؟
expected_facts: never let the Arabic page canonicalise to English
items.q_reworded: To avoid duplicate content, can we point the Arabic page's canonical to the English one?
answer_must: Never; each language version is self-canonical
Link them with hreflang instead

items.q_en: What must every public page pass before we invest in content?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب أن تجتازه كل صفحة عامة قبل أن نستثمر في المحتوى؟
items.q_reworded: Before writing blog content, what technical basics must the site pass?
answer_must: Indexable pages with self-referencing canonicals
No redirect chains, working sitemap and robots

items.q_en: Should buyer and supplier keyword research be done together?
items.q_ar: هل يجرى بحث الكلمات المفتاحية للمشترين والموردين معاً؟
items.q_reworded: Can one keyword list serve both contractors and the companies hiring them?
answer_must: No, research each side separately
Their intent and vocabulary differ

items.q_en: Can we generate a page for every trade in every emirate?
items.q_ar: هل يمكننا إنشاء صفحة لكل تخصص في كل إمارة؟
items.q_reworded: Can we auto-create a page for every trade in every emirate to grab traffic?
answer_must: Mass thin pages count as scaled content abuse
Only publish pages with unique, useful local substance

items.q_en: Which element of E-E-A-T matters most for our pages?
items.q_ar: أي عنصر من عناصر الخبرة والتخصص والموثوقية والثقة هو الأهم لصفحاتنا؟
items.q_reworded: Of experience, expertise, authoritativeness and trust, which matters most for our site?
answer_must: Trust is the most important
Show verifiable company facts, people and process

items.q_en: Does a small creator with few followers need a permit to post paid content about us?
items.q_ar: هل يحتاج صانع محتوى صغير بعدد متابعين قليل إلى تصريح لنشر محتوى مدفوع عنا؟
items.q_reworded: A micro-influencer with 900 followers will post about us for a fee. Does she need a licence?
answer_must: Yes, there is no follower-count threshold
The Advertiser Permit regime applies from 1 February 2026

items.q_en: Can we use the email from an RFQ to send marketing newsletters?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز استخدام البريد الإلكتروني الوارد في طلب عرض سعر لإرسال نشرات تسويقية؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer gave his email to receive quotes. Can we put him on our newsletter?
answer_must: No, a transactional email is not automatically marketing consent
Get explicit opt-in first under PDPL

items.q_en: What must we collect from a creator before any collaboration?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب أن نحصل عليه من صانع المحتوى قبل أي تعاون؟
items.q_reworded: Before signing any creator deal, what paperwork do we ask for?
answer_must: Their Advertiser Permit number
A written agreement with disclosure obligations

items.q_en: During which hours may we make marketing calls to suppliers?
items.q_ar: في أي ساعات يجوز لنا إجراء المكالمات التسويقية للموردين؟
items.q_reworded: What times are we allowed to phone suppliers to pitch registration?
answer_must: Only between 9 am and 6 pm
Do not call numbers on the Do Not Call Register

items.q_en: Can our ads compare QuotesDone with a competitor platform?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز أن تقارن إعلاناتنا بين QuotesDone ومنصة منافسة؟
items.q_reworded: Can our ad say we are better than a named rival platform?
answer_must: Comparisons are allowed only if truthful and not misleading
Claims must be substantiated; no disparagement

items.q_en: What company size fits our supplier ideal customer profile?
items.q_ar: ما حجم الشركة الذي يناسب ملف المورد المثالي لدينا؟
items.q_reworded: Which supplier companies should recruitment target first by size?
answer_must: Companies of about 2-200 staff
In trades where buyers post demand

items.q_en: Which side of the marketplace should marketing prioritise in 2026?
items.q_ar: أي جانب من السوق يجب أن يعطيه التسويق الأولوية في عام 2026؟
expected_facts: one confirmed supplier gates every RFQ
items.q_reworded: With little budget, should we chase buyers or suppliers first this year?
answer_must: Focus on the constrained side, suppliers, first
Every RFQ needs at least one confirmed supplier

items.q_en: Can we pay cash for every referred supplier sign-up?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز أن ندفع مبلغاً نقدياً عن كل مورد مسجل عبر الإحالة؟
items.q_reworded: Could we pay AED 100 per supplier who signs up through a referral link?
answer_must: No cash per sign-up
Reward only real, qualified outcomes

items.q_en: Can we publish a savings percentage in a customer case study?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز نشر نسبة توفير في دراسة حالة لعميل؟
items.q_reworded: A happy client says we saved them 30%. Can we put that in the case study?
answer_must: No savings percentage without evidence
Case studies need approval and verified facts

items.q_en: Which framework do we use to define our positioning?
items.q_ar: ما الإطار الذي نستخدمه لتحديد تموضع العلامة؟
items.q_reworded: How do we decide what we stand for compared to alternatives?
answer_must: Use April Dunford's positioning method
Start from competitive alternatives and unique value

items.q_en: Should our Arabic website copy be written in Emirati dialect?
items.q_ar: هل تكتب نصوص موقعنا العربية باللهجة الإماراتية؟
items.q_reworded: Should the Arabic site sound like local Emirati speech?
answer_must: Use Modern Standard Arabic for the website
Write Arabic natively, not translated from English

items.q_en: How should our brand voice sound in copy?
items.q_ar: كيف يجب أن يبدو صوت علامتنا في النصوص؟
items.q_reworded: What personality should our written copy have?
answer_must: Like a knowledgeable procurement colleague
Plain, specific and calm, not hype

items.q_en: When is Ramadan 2027 expected to begin in the UAE?
items.q_ar: متى يتوقع أن يبدأ شهر رمضان 2027 في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: When do we expect the 2027 fasting month to start in the Emirates?
answer_must: Around 8 February 2027
Subject to moon sighting

items.q_en: Which post format should we use for buyer education on LinkedIn?
items.q_ar: ما صيغة المنشور التي نستخدمها لتثقيف المشترين على لينكدإن؟
items.q_reworded: What kind of LinkedIn post works best to teach buyers how procurement works?
answer_must: Document/carousel posts
Educational, one idea per post

items.q_en: Do hashtags increase reach on our social posts?
items.q_ar: هل تزيد الوسوم من انتشار منشوراتنا على وسائل التواصل؟
items.q_reworded: Will adding 20 hashtags make our posts reach more people?
answer_must: No, hashtags are not a reach engine
Use a few relevant ones for categorisation

items.q_en: What happens to a post that fails one item of the quality checklist?
items.q_ar: ماذا يحدث لمنشور لا يجتاز بنداً واحداً من قائمة الجودة؟
expected_facts: passes all items or is held
items.q_reworded: A post is perfect except the Arabic was not reviewed. Can it go out?
answer_must: No, a post passes all items or is held
No partial passes

items.q_en: When should the National Day greeting be posted?
items.q_ar: متى تنشر التهنئة باليوم الوطني؟
expected_facts: no posting on the public-holiday days
items.q_reworded: Can we publish our 2 December greeting on the holiday itself?
answer_must: No posting on the public-holiday days
Schedule the greeting before the holiday

items.q_en: What video length fits a problem-agitate-solve explainer?
items.q_ar: ما مدة الفيديو المناسبة لشرح يعرض المشكلة ويضخمها ثم يقدم الحل؟
items.q_reworded: How long should a problem-agitate-solve explainer video run?
answer_must: About 30-60 seconds
Hook in the first seconds

items.q_en: Why does the hook matter so much in short video?
items.q_ar: لماذا تعد الافتتاحية مهمة جداً في الفيديو القصير؟
items.q_reworded: Why do people say the first second of a short video is everything?
answer_must: Platforms distribute based on watch-through
The hook decides distribution

items.q_en: Can we offer a discount to buyers who leave a Google review?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز تقديم خصم للمشترين الذين يكتبون مراجعة على جوجل؟
items.q_reworded: Could we give buyers 10% off if they rate us five stars on Google?
answer_must: No, incentivised or gated reviews break Google policy
Review gating violates the fake-engagement policy

items.q_en: How quickly must we reply to a Google review?
items.q_ar: بأي سرعة يجب أن نرد على مراجعة في جوجل؟
items.q_reworded: A one-star Google review came in Friday afternoon. How soon do we reply?
answer_must: Within one working day
Calm, factual, move details to private

items.q_en: How should UTM parameters be formatted for our campaigns?
items.q_ar: كيف يجب تنسيق معاملات UTM لحملاتنا؟
items.q_reworded: How do we write campaign tags in our tracking links?
answer_must: UTM values all lowercase with a fixed naming scheme
No personal data in UTM parameters

items.q_en: One post did twice as well as another; do we change strategy?
items.q_ar: حقق منشور ضعف أداء منشور آخر، فهل نغير الاستراتيجية؟
items.q_reworded: Post A got 2x the engagement of post B. Do we switch our strategy?
answer_must: Never declare a winner on small samples
Wait for enough data and a pre-set rule

items.q_en: Can a promotional offer be sent as a WhatsApp utility template?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز إرسال عرض ترويجي كقالب خدمي على واتساب؟
items.q_reworded: Can we send a discount offer through the WhatsApp template type used for account updates?
answer_must: No, utility templates must be non-promotional
Promotions need marketing templates and opt-in

items.q_en: What does a sender of 5,000 emails a day to Gmail need beyond SPF?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يحتاجه مرسل 5,000 رسالة يومياً إلى جيميل إضافة إلى SPF؟
items.q_reworded: We will email about 5,000 Gmail users daily. Is SPF alone enough?
answer_must: No, both SPF and DKIM plus DMARC
Plus one-click unsubscribe and low complaint rates

items.q_en: Will a product launch alone earn press coverage?
items.q_ar: هل يكفي إطلاق منتج وحده للحصول على تغطية صحفية؟
expected_facts: Product launches alone rarely earn coverage
items.q_reworded: If we announce our launch, will journalists write about it?
answer_must: Product launches alone rarely earn coverage
Offer data or a story journalists need

items.q_en: When and where is Big 5 Global in 2026?
items.q_ar: متى وأين يقام معرض Big 5 Global في عام 2026؟
items.q_reworded: When is the big Dubai construction trade show this year and where?
answer_must: Big 5 Global, 23-26 November 2026
At Dubai World Trade Centre

items.q_en: Which edits restart the Meta learning phase?
items.q_ar: ما التعديلات التي تعيد مرحلة التعلم في ميتا؟
items.q_reworded: If I change the ad set budget a lot, does Meta start learning again?
answer_must: Significant edits reset learning
Learning needs about 50 optimisation events per week

items.q_en: Does a negative keyword block its plural and misspellings automatically?
items.q_ar: هل تحجب الكلمة المفتاحية السلبية صيغة الجمع والأخطاء الإملائية تلقائياً؟
items.q_reworded: I excluded "cheap" in Google Ads. Will "cheaper" also be blocked?
answer_must: No, negative keywords do not match close variants
Add plurals and misspellings explicitly

items.q_en: When should we rotate the creative in a retargeting ad set?
items.q_ar: متى يجب تبديل التصميم الإعلاني في مجموعة إعلانات إعادة الاستهداف؟
expected_facts: CTR falls by roughly a third
items.q_reworded: Our retargeting ads are getting fewer clicks each week. When do we refresh them?
answer_must: When CTR falls by roughly a third from its baseline
Keep 3-5 live creatives rotating

items.q_en: How long does LinkedIn keep Lead Gen Form data?
items.q_ar: كم يحتفظ لينكدإن ببيانات نماذج جمع العملاء المحتملين؟
items.q_reworded: How long can we pull leads from LinkedIn forms before they vanish?
answer_must: Lead data is available for 90 days, download before then
Forms allow up to three custom questions

items.q_en: How is engagement rate by reach calculated?
items.q_ar: كيف يحسب معدل التفاعل بالنسبة إلى الوصول؟
items.q_reworded: How do we compute engagement rate based on reach?
answer_must: Interactions divided by reach
Times 100 for a percentage

items.q_en: Where does marketing send a lead that came from a social post?
items.q_ar: إلى أين يرسل التسويق عميلاً محتملاً جاء من منشور على وسائل التواصل؟
items.q_reworded: Someone commented asking for a quote on a villa fit-out. Who handles it?
answer_must: Pass it to sales_engineer via social.lead
The originator closes the loop

items.q_en: Can our copy say buyers see only three quotes?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز أن تذكر نصوصنا أن المشترين يرون ثلاثة عروض فقط؟
items.q_reworded: Can the ad copy say "we show you only three quotes"?
answer_must: Never write "only three shown"
Also: suppliers pay no commission

items.q_en: What happens if a revealed supplier does not respond?
items.q_ar: ماذا يحدث إذا لم يرد المورد الذي كشفت هويته؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer asks what happens if the supplier he unlocked never calls back.
answer_must: If the supplier does not respond within 5 working days the buyer is refunded automatically
The supplier owes the non-response charge

items.q_en: I have a campaign idea. What is the first thing to establish?
items.q_ar: لدي فكرة حملة، ما أول ما يجب تحديده؟
items.q_reworded: Before I pitch a new campaign concept to the CEO, what do I need to answer first?
answer_must: Which company KPI it moves
Audience, evidence and stop rule

items.q_en: When should we not recommend paid spend on a channel?
items.q_ar: متى لا نوصي بالإنفاق المدفوع على قناة ما؟
expected_facts: cost per reveal exceeds the fee
items.q_reworded: When should we refuse to recommend spending on ads for a channel?
answer_must: When cost per reveal exceeds the fee earned
When gates are not met (categories closed, no approved budget)

items.q_en: What should the Organization JSON-LD on our home page contain?
items.q_ar: ماذا يجب أن يتضمن ترميز JSON-LD الخاص بالمؤسسة في صفحتنا الرئيسية؟
expected_facts: legalName exactly as on the DET licence
items.q_reworded: Google is showing our company name inconsistently. What markup do we add to the homepage to fix who we are?
answer_must: Use Organization schema in JSON-LD with the legal name exactly as licensed and the brand name
List all official profiles in sameAs
Validate it with Google Rich Results Test / schema validator

items.q_en: Where do answer engines take the facts they state about a brand?
items.q_ar: من أين تأخذ محركات الإجابة الحقائق التي تذكرها عن علامة تجارية؟
items.q_reworded: Our own site is good but ChatGPT still never mentions us. Where else do we need to show up?
answer_must: Engines rely on facts corroborated by several independent sources and often cite third-party pages
Earn press with original data, directory listings and genuine reviews
Map which domains engines cite for our questions and target those

items.q_en: Our reveal fee wording changed. What must marketing do the same day?
items.q_ar: تغيرت صياغة رسوم الكشف لدينا. ماذا يجب على التسويق فعله في اليوم نفسه؟
items.q_reworded: The accountant just told me a fee changed; how do we stop ChatGPT repeating the old number?
answer_must: Update the single fact register first
Regenerate every page, schema, llms.txt and profile that shows it the same day and request recrawl (Search Console, IndexNow)
Re-check engine answers after a few weeks

items.q_en: How long should a paragraph answer be to win a featured snippet?
items.q_ar: ما طول الفقرة المناسبة للفوز بمقتطف مميز؟
items.q_reworded: We want Google to show our text in the answer box at the top. How should we write that part?
answer_must: Put a short 40-60 word direct answer right under a question heading
Match the snippet type: paragraph, list or table
Answer the literal question in the first sentence and avoid facts that mislead out of context

items.q_en: What must every campaign have before it starts?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب أن يتوفر في كل حملة قبل أن تبدأ؟
expected_facts: one objective, one audience, one primary KPI and a stop rule
items.q_reworded: Sales wants us to launch something big for suppliers next week. What do we pin down before saying yes?
answer_must: A single objective and a single audience
One primary KPI
A stop rule decided in advance

items.q_en: Which caption framework fits pain-driven buyer content?
items.q_ar: أي إطار للتعليقات يناسب المحتوى الموجه للمشترين القائم على المشكلة؟
items.q_reworded: I need a caption for a post about buyers getting three quotes they cannot compare. How do I structure it?
answer_must: Use Problem-Agitate-Solve: name the pain, sharpen its cost, then give the fix
One idea and one call to action
Facts checked against the register before publishing

items.q_en: Where do we look for trends and how fast must we decide?
items.q_ar: أين نبحث عن الاتجاهات الرائجة وبأي سرعة يجب أن نقرر؟
items.q_reworded: A sound is blowing up on Reels this week. How do we judge whether to jump on it?
answer_must: Check it against our audience and content pillars, and its origin and political/religious sensitivity
Decide quickly, within about two days, because trends decay
Use only audio cleared for commercial use

items.q_en: On which days may QuotesDone publish posts?
items.q_ar: في أي أيام يجوز لـ QuotesDone نشر المنشورات؟
expected_facts: no posting on weekends or UAE public holidays
items.q_reworded: We missed Thursday's slot. Can I just push it out on Saturday?
answer_must: No posting on weekends (Saturday-Sunday) or UAE public holidays
A missed slot is skipped, not moved to a weekend
Only founder-approved content from the monthly plan is published

items.q_en: How many content pillars should we have and how far ahead is the calendar built?
items.q_ar: كم ركيزة محتوى يجب أن تكون لدينا وكم من الوقت مسبقاً تُبنى الخطة؟
items.q_reworded: How should next quarter's social plan be organised so it is not random posting?
answer_must: A few (3-5) recurring themes tied to positioning, every post belongs to one
A monthly calendar prepared weeks in advance and approved
Reserve some capacity for reactive posts and repurpose each piece

items.q_en: What does Instagram rank Reels on?
items.q_ar: على أي أساس يرتّب إنستغرام مقاطع ريلز؟
expected_facts: watch it all the way through
items.q_reworded: Can we just upload our TikTok videos to Instagram as they are?
answer_must: No: watermarked or low-quality reels are shown less; render native versions
Reels are ranked mainly on likely reshares, full watch-through and likes
Use 9:16 with text inside safe zones and captions on

items.q_en: How fast must we answer social comments and DMs?
items.q_ar: بأي سرعة يجب أن نرد على التعليقات والرسائل الخاصة؟
items.q_reworded: Someone left an angry comment on our LinkedIn post. Should we delete it?
answer_must: Do not hide legitimate criticism; respond to it, and only hide spam, abuse or exposed personal data
Reply in business hours within one to two hours and move details to DM
Route complaints to customer_support and leads to sales_engineer

items.q_en: What colour contrast must our post graphics meet?
items.q_ar: ما نسبة تباين الألوان المطلوبة في تصاميم منشوراتنا؟
items.q_reworded: A visually impaired contractor says our posts are hard to use. What should we change?
answer_must: Add meaningful alt text and accurate captions
Meet contrast of at least 4.5:1 and never rely on colour alone
Use CamelCase hashtags and descriptive links

items.q_en: Which UAE law and standards govern our social content?
items.q_ar: ما القانون والمعايير الإماراتية التي تحكم محتوانا على وسائل التواصل؟
items.q_reworded: Can we use the UAE flag and a leadership quote in our National Day ad?
answer_must: The UAE media law and Media Council content standards apply
No commercial use of national symbols or leadership references without permission, no political or religious content
Ads must be identifiable as ads and not misleading

items.q_en: Does Google penalise content drafted with a model?
items.q_ar: هل يعاقب Google المحتوى المكتوب بمساعدة نموذج لغوي؟
expected_facts: not against its guidelines per se
items.q_reworded: Is it OK if the blog posts are written by our assistant tool rather than a person?
answer_must: Machine-assisted content is acceptable if helpful and original; mass content to manipulate rankings is spam
Every draft is reviewed and facts traced to the register
Disclose realistic synthetic media per platform rules and never fake people or testimonials

items.q_en: Why would Meta reject an ad that says "Struggling to pay your contractor?"
items.q_ar: لماذا قد ترفض ميتا إعلاناً يقول "هل تواجه صعوبة في الدفع لمقاولك؟"
items.q_reworded: Our Facebook ad got disapproved and we do not know why. What usually trips B2B ads?
answer_must: Copy implying the viewer's personal attributes (e.g. financial status) is rejected
The ad must match what the landing page offers
Edit and resubmit or appeal through Account Quality

items.q_en: At what point does a social problem become a Level 2 crisis and who is told?
items.q_ar: متى تصبح مشكلة على وسائل التواصل أزمة من المستوى الثاني ومن يُبلَّغ؟
items.q_reworded: A complaint about one of our suppliers is going viral on X. What do we do first?
answer_must: Pause scheduled posts and paid activity
Notify ceo and customer_support quickly and establish facts before speaking
Acknowledge publicly fast, move individuals to private channels, never speculate

items.q_en: What counts as an invited supplier in the acquisition funnel?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يُعد مورداً مدعواً في مسار استقطاب الموردين؟
expected_facts: a status column is not a delivery record
items.q_reworded: The dashboard says 171 suppliers were invited. Is that the number to report?
answer_must: Only an invitation actually delivered through the outbox counts, not a status flag
Measure each stage: sourced, invited, registered, verified, activated, retained
Prioritise trades where buyers post and coverage is thin

items.q_en: Can buyers and suppliers share one landing page?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن أن يتشارك المشترون والموردون صفحة هبوط واحدة؟
expected_facts: Never send buyers and suppliers to the same page
items.q_reworded: We are running one ad for everyone. Where should the link go?
answer_must: Each side gets its own page with its own headline and single CTA
Buyer page explains the 3% reveal fee plainly; supplier page states cost and verification
Ad message must match the page; an Arabic twin page exists

items.q_en: How long is the free window after a click-to-WhatsApp ad conversation starts?
items.q_ar: ما مدة النافذة المجانية بعد بدء محادثة من إعلان النقر إلى واتساب؟
items.q_reworded: If a contractor messages us from an Instagram ad on WhatsApp, can we send him promotions later?
answer_must: A chat is not marketing consent; record explicit opt-in
Messages are free for 72 hours from our first reply in an ad-started conversation
Judge the ad on cost per verified supplier or posted request
